description: Send a chat message to a Skopik agent and wait for its reply. Continues your standing session with the agent unless session_id (from a previous call) is given. Returns the reply when it arrives within wait_seconds; otherwise returns the session id to poll.

session_id.description: Existing session id to continue. Omit to use your standing session with the agent.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the reply (default 25; 0 sends without waiting).

name: skopik_agent_message

message_id.description: Id of the message that was sent.

reply.description: The agent's reply text, when it arrived in time.

title: Message an agent
